column1: # Reconstructed 2026-10-01: the original manifest was not included in the
# initial public commit. Ports, paths and fixtures come from each config; the
# wrk shape (-t16 -c512, 30s measure, 5s warmup, 20s cooldown) comes from
# DESIGN.md / bench/README.md. The *_low_concurrency shape (-t4 -c32) is a
# best guess; baselines re-captured with it on 2026-10-01. m19_stream_128m
# uses -c64: at -c512 each 128 MiB response takes longer than wrk's 2s
# 0.1.2 performance campaign (added 2026-10-06). Same wrk shape unless the
# _c4096 = -t16 -c4096. `lua` header mode runs the given wrk script.
map_regex_50|map with 50 regex keys, last one matches|8110|/maprx/k49|16|512|30s|5s|20|bench/core2/nginx.conf||none||http
